---
# plik: recipes/placuszki-bananowe.md
schema_version: 1
title: "Placuszki bananowe dla całej rodziny"
description: "Przepis ze znacznikami KIDS i NORM (fixture testów)."
servings: 4
prep_minutes: 10
cook_minutes: 12
tags: [deser, kids, norm]
source: "fixture testów"

ingredients:
  - name: "Banany"
    amount: 2
    unit: pcs
  - name: "Jajka"
    amount: 2
    unit: pcs
  - name: "Mąka pszenna"
    amount: 120
    unit: g
  - name: "Mleko"
    amount: 150
    unit: ml

steps:
  - text: "Rozgnieć banany widelcem i wymieszaj z jajkami."
  - text: "Dodaj mąkę i mleko, wymieszaj na gładkie ciasto."
  - text: "Smaż małe placuszki na rozgrzanej patelni z obu stron na złoto."

translations:
  en:
    title: "Banana pancakes for the whole family"
    description: "A recipe with the KIDS and NORM badges (test fixture)."
    ingredients:
      - name: "Bananas"
      - name: "Eggs"
      - name: "Plain flour"
      - name: "Milk"
    steps:
      - text: "Mash the bananas with a fork and mix with the eggs."
      - text: "Add the flour and milk, mix into a smooth batter."
      - text: "Fry small pancakes in a hot pan until golden on both sides."
